title: Listings
description: Manage product and service listings for your tenant storefront.

help.title: About listings
help.overview: A listing is a service you offer: what you do, in which category and area, and at what price. Clients can order it once it's active.

sections.title: Set it up
items: Title, category, main image, price and currency describe it; description, photos, videos, tags and requirements are optional.
The pricing type is fixed or hourly. Delivery days set an order's default due date.
Location and service area place it: for on-site work, you hear about clients' jobs in its category whose address is inside your service area.
Packages (such as Basic, Standard, Premium) and add-ons let clients choose more; you manage them on their own pages.

sections.title: Status and reach
items: A new listing starts as a draft. Activate needs a price and a currency; Deactivate takes it offline without deleting it.
A promotion puts it first in the recommended list for its dates. Reviews give it its rating.
Users can report a listing; an administrator decides, and can take it offline.
Unless you are an administrator, you change only the listings you provide.
